svg.title: The Blue Carbuncle, from jewel-case to goose: the theft on 22 December, the stone pushed into a goose, the geese sold through Covent Garden and the Alpha Inn, Baker's dropped goose on Christmas morning and the stone found on 27 December.
svg.desc: A vertical timeline of five entries. 22 December: the blue carbuncle is stolen at the Hotel Cosmopolitan and the plumber John Horner is arrested. 22 December: James Ryder pushes the stone into a goose at his sister's in Brixton Road and then takes the wrong bird. 22 December: her 24 geese are sold to Breckinridge in Covent Garden, and 24 go on to the landlord of the Alpha Inn. 25 December, about four in the morning: Henry Baker drops his club goose in a street fight and Peterson takes goose and hat to Holmes. 27 December: Peterson's wife finds the stone in the goose's crop and Holmes traces the chain.
svg.text: The Blue Carbuncle: from jewel-case to goose
The blue carbuncle is stolen at the Hotel Cosmopolitan;
the plumber John Horner is arrested that evening.
James Ryder pushes the stone into a goose at his sister's
(Mrs. Oakshott, Brixton Road), then takes the wrong bird.
Her 24 geese are sold to Breckinridge, Covent Garden,
and 24 go on to the landlord of the Alpha Inn.
About 4 a.m. Henry Baker drops his club goose in a
street fight; Peterson takes goose and hat to Holmes.
Peterson's wife finds the stone in the goose's crop;
Holmes traces the chain back that night.
